title: Zero locus is the whole scheme iff the morphism is zero
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M$ and $N$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\varphi:M\to N$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism. Then $\varphi.zeroLocus=\bot$ if and only if $\varphi=0$.
